what: Download and preparation wall times of real runs, with the request each downloaded, for the time estimate in estimate_times.py
machine: node-4, RTX 5070 Ti (16 GB), 24 CPU cores, its own network link
how: each run's fetch and prepare stage_finished events (wall_seconds), and the bytes its fetch reported, entered before the run folders were deleted; cells are the 3-D grid cells of all its grids

prepared:hrrr.why: the HRRR preparation decodes every native file it downloaded, about 1.2 GB per forcing time: the 162 by 162 and 352 by 342 point grids took 6.4 and 6.1 s per forcing time, while their cells differ 4.6 times

experiment.why: the ERA5 route reads a small crop and spends its preparation on the grid: its three runs took 14.8, 31.9 and 23.0 s, 1.3 to 2.3 microseconds per cell and forcing time (6.7, 14.1 and 18.1 million), against 0.3 to 1.7 s per MB of their 8.8, 67 and 82 MB downloads

runs.note: the event page's 12 GB layout; the shared disk was nearly full during the preparation
